description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Maulfist Squad, adding {C}{C}.
When Maulfist Squad dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Maulfist Squad from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Maulfist Squad enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
